The JSON files are the examples of the LocalSend protocol README
(https://github.com/localsend/protocol, section 3 and 4) with the JSON5
comments removed. `localsend-cert.pem` and its fingerprint
`4BADDE53A7F7CDEEED93189FD898E02BF6B4806CA4C05DE0ACE08319B86552FA` are the
test vector of LocalSend's own `packages/core/src/crypto/cert.rs`.
